prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI completed feedback page redesign concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for complete feedback state and information architecture, not an edit target.
Primary request: Redesign 14-E-01-short-answer-feedback/complete.
Direction: score-first feedback dashboard.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Preserve complete feedback state: left app sidebar, top total score summary, four dimension feedback cards, sentence-level correction section, recommended learning cards, and bottom actions for retry, next problem, save, and comparison report. No loading or incomplete state.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design Dashboard/Card/Statistic/List/Button UI, compact TOPIK study workspace with 4-8px panel radii.
Color palette: Mist canvas, Snow panels, Fog rows/dividers, Ink/Steel text, Obsidian #09090b for one primary action only.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans font, readable Korean passage areas, compact weight hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: score and completed feedback must be unmistakable; color signals must be paired with text/icons; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, AI gradient, colorful repeated CTAs, heavy card shadows, fake loading spinner, raw debug fixture text, watermark.
